nodes.title: proSamik/desktop-bridge
nodes.description: Agent Desktop Remote Control via Cloudflare Tunnel: self-hosted remote MCP server that lets Claude and other AI agents run Claude Code (claude -p) and OpenAI Codex CLI on your Mac, Linux and Windows machines. OAuth 2.1, admin panel, parallel runs.

nodes.title: TGYD-helige/pi
nodes.description: Pluggable extension packages for the Pi AI-agent runtime. Each package exposes LLM-callable tools via MCP — covering IM workspace integrations (Lark, DingTalk, WeCom), browser & computer automation, persistent memory, telemetry, task scheduling, image generation, web access, security policies, and more.

nodes.title: mmxb8/UltraTransfer
nodes.description: High-performance open-source AI agent infrastructure for secure data exchange, verified context synchronization, adaptive caching, and reproducible performance engineering.

nodes.title: apify/apify-mcp-server
nodes.description: The Apify MCP server enables your AI agents to extract data from social media, search engines, maps, e-commerce sites, or any other website using thousands of ready-made scrapers, crawlers, and automation tools available on the Apify Store.

nodes.title: ianlyoo/artemis
nodes.description: Self-hosted AI agent team on your computer or an always-on Linux server: one lead over Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and any OpenAI-compatible API, a vault for keys, approval cards, and an App for desktop and phone.

nodes.title: kota-kawa/Marmo-Core
nodes.description: Python kernel and CLI for AI agents: route a goal to the right Memory, Skill, Tool, and Agent resources, then run them through policy gates, human approval, and a hash-chained audit log.

nodes.title: Nalam-Karthik/stepwise
nodes.description: Durable runtime for LLM agents: crash-safe journaled steps, exactly-once tool effects, human approval gates and cost budgets. FastAPI + Postgres + Claude.

nodes.title: HackingGate/uphold
nodes.description: Reduce reliance on AGENTS.md and other plain-text instructions that guide agents. LLMs are probabilistic, so don't rely solely on Markdown instructions. Use tools that actually enforce your rules; make them behave more like a linter or a compiler.  (The tool is still in an early stage, so its behavior and interfaces may change significantly.)

nodes.title: aditya-13115/openCODE
nodes.description: My personal OpenCode development environment featuring curated AI agent skills, Superpowers workflows, Hugging Face and MLflow tooling, Anthropic skills, OpenAgents, browser automation, and reusable configurations for AI-assisted coding, debugging, testing, code reviews, and LLM development.

nodes.title: billy-enrizky/openbrowser-ai
nodes.description: OpenBrowser is a framework for intelligent browser automation. It combines direct CDP communication with a CodeAgent architecture, where the LLM writes Python code executed in a persistent namespace, to navigate, interact with, and extract information from web pages autonomously.

nodes.title: zanta0529/pocket-agent
nodes.description: A local-first CLI AI agent with ChatGPT OAuth, Ollama, and multiple cloud LLM providers. Supports subagents, MCP integrations, browser automation, and Word/PDF/PowerPoint generation.

nodes.title: lightpanda-io/browser
nodes.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation

nodes.title: RoboFinSystems/robosystems-app
nodes.description: Part of RoboSystems, the open-source knowledge graph for finance. Its web app: graphs, MCP connections, Cypher, documents, subgraphs, memory and the SEC repository. Next.js, deployable to your own AWS account.

nodes.title: protechtus/sextant
nodes.description: Self-hosted AI memory and orchestration: MCP memory server, temporal knowledge graph, transcript capture, local task queue. No cloud required.

nodes.title: vbcherepanov/total-agent-memory
nodes.description: Persistent local memory for AI coding agents — Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor, any MCP client. Temporal knowledge graph, procedural memory, AST codebase ingest, cross-project analogy. LongMemEval R@5 95.1%, LoCoMo 0.607, BEAM 1M 0.448. 74 MCP tools, 9 IDEs, 100% local.

nodes.title: doobidoo/mcp-memory-service
nodes.description: Open-source persistent memory for AI agent pipelines (LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen) and Claude. REST API + knowledge graph + autonomous consolidation.

nodes.title: HelpCode-ai/anythingmcp
nodes.description: Enterprise Agent Harness & MCP Gateway: connect APIs, databases, file servers and 600+ connectors (SAP, Odoo, Etsy…) to Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot and your agents. Memory, skills, knowledge graph, SSO/RBAC, audit log and governance built in. Your AI company brain.

nodes.title: Comfy-Org/ComfyUI
nodes.description: The most powerful and modular diffusion model GUI, api and backend with a graph/nodes interface. The fastest local inference engine in the world.

nodes.title: mdjunaid-11/browser-ai
nodes.description: A private, voice-enabled AI companion that runs entirely in your browser. Features local LLM inference, speech recognition, text-to-speech, animated animal companions, and persistent chat. No backend, accounts, telemetry, or paid APIs. Powered by Transformers.js and ONNX Runtime Web.

nodes.title: opentail-net/OpenTail.Stingray
nodes.description: Local AI, native to .NET. Run language models, vision, speech, and generative AI directly in your C# applications. No Python. No external inference server. CPU or GPU. Open source, built for NativeAOT.

nodes.title: 1bit-MONSTER/engine
nodes.description: One binary to rule them all: model-agnostic local LLM inference for AMD Strix Halo (Ryzen AI MAX+ 395) on Linux. Radeon 8060S iGPU (gfx1151) via HRX + our HIP kernels, XDNA 2 NPU via our NPU runtime, inside Lemonade Server with an OpenAI-compatible API. Qwen3.8, ZAYA1, BitNet b1.58, any GGUF. Apache-2.0.

nodes.title: dahai80/fusion-gateway
nodes.description: Fusion-Gateway is a lightweight high-performance API gateway built for local AI model orchestration on macOS. It unifies multi-model access, streamlines inference routing, and optimizes resource scheduling for MLX-based AI workflows.
